verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only the interactive web portal: online filing, dashboards, FranceConnect+ login, and payment modalities for high-volume mandataires. It shows no API, system account, transmitter program, or batch-provider channel for software to file with the Guichet unique, and no enrollment path for one. The keyless recherche-entreprises probe concerns a separate read-only state data API, not a transactional rail into this service, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
